resources.string: Shows the first text when the value is set (not empty, false, 0 or no), else the second: {if:value|then|else}
Shows the first text when the value is not set, else the second: {if.not:value|then|else}
Shows the first text when both values are set, else the second: {if.all:a|b|then|else}
Shows the first text when at least one value is set, else the second: {if.any:a|b|then|else}
Shows the first text when the value is empty, else the second: {if.empty:value|then|else}
Shows the first text when a helper such as stream.live is set, else the second: {if.stream.live:then|else}
Tests that a helper equals a text, exactly: {if.user.login.equals:text:then|else}
Tests that a helper equals a text, ignoring upper and lower case: {if.user.login.iequals:text:then|else}
Tests that a helper contains a text: {if.args.all.contains:text:then|else}
Tests that a helper starts with a text: {if.args.1.startswith:text:then|else}
Tests that a helper ends with a text: {if.args.all.endswith:text:then|else}
Tests that a helper matches a regular expression: {if.args.2.matches:pattern:then|else}
Tests that a helper is a number greater than a number: {if.count.deaths.gt:10:then|else}
Tests that a helper is a number less than a number: {if.stream.viewers.lt:10:then|else}
Tests that a helper is a number greater than or equal to a number: {if.user.months.gte:6:then|else}
Tests that a helper is a number less than or equal to a number: {if.count.wins.lte:3:then|else}
The value, or the fallback when the value is empty: {default:value|fallback}
The first value that is not empty: {coalesce:a|b|c}
Picks the text of the first case that equals the value, else the last text: {switch:value|case=text|case=text|else}
Picks the text of the first limit that is at least the number, else the last text: {switch.range:number|limit=text|limit=text|else}
Shows the first text with the given chance in percent, else the second: {chance:10|then|else}
Picks one of the texts at random, never the same twice in a row: {pick:a|b|c}
Picks one text at random, a bigger weight is more likely: {pick.weighted:1=rare|9=common}
Picks a number of different texts at random: {pick.n:2|a|b|c}
Lists all texts in a random order: {pick.shuffle:a|b|c}
Picks one item of a list written with semicolons, so an item may hold a pipe: {pick.inline:a;b;c}
A random whole number: {random.number:6} is 1 to 6, {random.number:10|50|10} is 10, 20 up to 50
A random number with decimals: {random.decimal:min|max|places}
A random percent from 0% to 100%
Randomly true or false, for use inside {if:...}
A random letter from A to Z
A random color as a hex code, such as #3FA7D6
The text as written, with nothing inside it resolved: {literal:{user}} shows {user}
Nothing at all, for an empty branch that reads clearly
A line break (for Discord and webhooks; chat shows a space)
A space
The pipe character, which would otherwise split arguments
A zero-width space, which stops a mention such as @everyone from working
